thesis: The page is a pocket field guide to what Portland trees drop into gutters: every clog is a numbered specimen plate, and every plate carries a drop-season bar that fills in the months you should book.

signature.name: Drop-Season Bars
signature.summary: A 12-cell month strip (J-D) under a hairline plate header with a Latin-name legend; cells fill in moss (rust for act-now months, dashed for rare specimens). Hero: 5 stacked bars as the key of a drawn range map, filling on load; specimen plates: each plate's bar fills after its line drawing draws; field notes: a single tick on the month a review names; price ledger: mini booking-season bars; cleaning calendar tool output is the bar; footer: full-year bar with the current month outlined.

palette.family: Fir Shade + Herbarium Bone + Moss + Rust Tag

layoutMoves: ruled specimen plates with sticky drawing column
range-map hero with bar key and ZIP legend
field-note cards in a 3-col masonry with Latin bylines
price ledger rows with mini season bars

motion.intro: Range hatch draws (700ms) while the 5 hero bars fill cell by cell (40ms stagger), total under 1.1s, skipped by any scroll or key; h1 visible at first paint.
stories: draw: each specimen plate's SVG line drawing draws on entry, then its season bar fills; sticky drawing column from 640px, 55svh per plate
fill: the cleaning calendar's 12-cell bar fills live as trees are picked
motion.hover: Cards and rows: empty bar cells take a 1px moss outline and the plate number nudges 4px right (200ms).
